ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed distribution favoring low-intensity pixels; approximately 15:1 ratio of dark surface area to high-intensity white highlights found primarily at the margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth continuous boundary with low-amplitude, irregular serrations; minor pixel-level peaks and valleys are more concentrated on the outer third of the trailing edge on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature extending from the central notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, tapered vertices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Identified high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the terminal distal points of both lobes, consistent with localized scarring or colonization patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white scarring at the lateral tips of both lobes; visible irregularity/notch in the trailing edge topography of the right lobe distal quadrant.
